verdict.rationale: Some peripheral source appears to be public: the official CLI is hosted in a public GitHub repo (newrelic/newrelic-cli), and a community comment refers to an 'open source agent'. Nothing indicates the core SaaS platform's source is readable, and no license terms are documented for any component. Missing for 10: evidence that the core platform source is available, explicit open-license terms for the CLI and agents, and first-party documentation of the open-source agent repositories.
